title: Tomorrow is Today
overview: A family is on holiday in 1991 when their teenage daughter decides to elope with her boyfriend. Their parents travel forward in time to 2022 and see how much Spain has changed in three decades.
plot:
Tomorrow Is Today (Spanish: Mañana es hoy) is a 2022 Spanish comedy film directed by Nacho G. Velilla, starring Javier Gutiérrez and Carmen Machi, with Asier Ricarte and Carla Díaz. Produced by Atresmedia Cine and Aparte Films for Amazon Prime Video, it is a time-travel comedy that contrasts Spanish family life in the early 1990s with the present day.

In the summer of 1991, José Luis Gaspar takes his wife Pilar and their teenage children, Lucía and Rodrigo, on a beach holiday. After an argument, Lucía leaves with her boyfriend Charly to go to a carnival, while the rest of the family go out to sea on a pedal boat. A sudden thunderstorm transports them to 2022. Returning to their old neighborhood, they find Quique, Rodrigo's best friend and José's former employee, now a middle-aged man, who tells them that Lucía died at the carnival in 1991. The family suspects that Charly killed her.

Determined to return to the past and save his daughter, José seeks help from a fortune teller, Ana Clara, and her cousin and assistant Elvirita. Meanwhile, Pilar and Rodrigo begin adapting to the modern world: Pilar finds a job in a fashion boutique, and Rodrigo goes back to high school with Quique's help and gets his first girlfriend. When José and Ana Clara track down an older Charly and confront him, the encounter ends in an accident. Eventually José manages to return to 1991 during another storm, where the family desperately tries to keep Lucía away from the carnival and discovers that the danger she faces does not come from where they expected.

Much of the film's humor comes from the family's encounters with smartphones, social media and changing social attitudes, while the story shifts toward drama in its final act.

Tomorrow Is Today premiered on Amazon Prime Video on 2 December 2022. Reviews were mixed: Cinemanía rated it four out of five stars, praising its parodic and witty style and its score, while Diario de Sevilla gave it one star, criticizing a lazy script that wastes the premise's possibilities. HobbyConsolas considered it acceptable, praising the premise and the cast but faulting the final act.

title: B&B Merry
overview: Tracey Wise is a renowned luxury travel blogger who is invited by Graham Cooper to a Christmas getaway in exchange for her review of his family’s small bed & breakfast, Silver Peak. Unfortunately, the humble B&B is facing tough competition from an upscale hotel resort nearby that has been stealing guests and threatening the survival of the family business.
plot:
B&B Merry is a 2022 Canadian Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Paula Elle from a screenplay by Hayley Carr and Guy Yosub. Produced by the Motion Picture Corporation of America and Brad Krevoy Television, it stars Jen Lilley and Jesse Hutch, with Shelly Williams, Kate Twa, Laura Yenga and Nick Preston in supporting roles. The film premiered on the Great American Family channel on 4 December 2022, runs 85 minutes and later became available to stream on Netflix.

Tracey Wise (Lilley) is a renowned luxury travel blogger with a large following, whose cheerful motto is that people can travel more if they travel wisely. One of her fans is Graham Cooper (Hutch), who helps his mother Barbara (Williams) run Silver Peak, a small family bed and breakfast in Vermont. Since a big upscale hotel resort opened nearby and began stealing their guests, the business has been struggling to survive, so Graham invites Tracey and her boyfriend Mark (Preston) on a Christmas getaway at the inn in exchange for a review. Just before the trip, Tracey learns of a potential job at a renowned travel magazine that requires a sample review, and since she is already heading to Vermont she decides to review the rival luxury hotel as well, planning to stay there first. When Graham bumps into her at a local coffee shop, however, he assumes she has arrived early and drives her straight to the B&B before she can explain, and she cannot bring herself to admit that she and Mark have just broken up, turning the romantic getaway into a trip for one. As the only guest, Tracey is lavished with attention by Barbara and her sister Sarah (Twa), who go overboard trying to make everything perfect and, once the truth about Mark comes out, notice a spark between Tracey and Graham and give the pair space. As Tracey falls for both the inn and Graham, her secret review of the competing hotel threatens to cause conflict.

Reviews were mixed. Kristen of TV Tweetie judged it "quietly good", a charming, relaxing film with a small cast and a narrow focus on romance, and found both leads natural, with perfect chemistry. Sneha Jaiswal of Abstract AF rated it 2 out of 5, praising its beautiful, festive Christmas settings and the fun older actors playing the matchmaking sisters, but finding the plot predictable within fifteen minutes, Lilley's portrayal lacking warmth and the leads devoid of chemistry, despite Hutch making a worthy romantic hero.

title: The Holiday Dating Guide
overview: Dating coach and aspiring book author Abigale Slater is tasked by her publisher Jack to prove that her dating advice really works. With that, she decides to make a man fall for her by Christmas Eve in 12 days. When she Michael Ryan, her single-minded mission takes an unexpected turn.
plot:
The Holiday Dating Guide is a 2022 American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Brian Herzlinger and produced by W Squared Media, Workhorse Cinema and ZMA Films. Made for Lifetime's It's a Wonderful Lifetime holiday season, it stars Maria Menounos as Abigale Slater and Brent Bailey as Michael Ryan, with Andrea Susan Bush, Kelly Lynn Reiter, Ava Paloma, Steve Vinovich, Mason McCulley, Jequrey Slaton, Kerry Malloy, Sarah Allyn, Thomas Wilson Pace and Amadeo Fusca. The film runs 85 minutes.

Abigale is a dating coach and aspiring self-help author who is on the verge of publishing her first book, a how-to guide to dating over the holidays. When she meets the publisher Jack, however, he argues that people should not need a guide to find love, because fate will bring the right two people together on their own. Abigale counters that times have changed and that there are tips worth following, and to prove that her advice really works she makes a bet with him: she will make a man fall for her within twelve days and bring him to Jack's Christmas Eve party as proof, in return for a book deal. She sets out following her own rules, which include not seeing a date two days in a row, staying mysterious and getting to know someone only lightly, but with so little time she is soon forced to bend them. When she meets Michael Ryan at a bar, she breaks one immediately by agreeing to a date straight away, and as their romance develops she sees him too often, learns too much about him, meets his friends too soon and falls too fast, although he falls just as quickly. Along the way she realises that sometimes it is better to follow one's instincts and be spontaneous, and that there is something underhanded about making someone fall in love as a test to advance her career. When Michael learns of the bet at the worst possible moment, he feels used, and Abigale must try to make things right before Christmas.

The film premiered on Lifetime in December 2022. Kristen of TV Tweetie found it cute but wildly predictable, crediting the cast, especially Bailey's appealing, down-to-earth performance, while objecting that a dating coach would embark on such a thoughtless scheme and that the story lacked emotional depth. Jade of Fangirlish called it a lighthearted, sweet seasonal romance that shone brighter because of the chemistry between Menounos and Bailey.

title: Record Breaking Christmas
overview: Working for the World Record Bureau, Leah Hoffman is forced to travel to a small town just before Christmas to investigate its plans to break multiple holiday world records. While there, she falls for the town’s doctor, Devan Bancroft.
plot:
Record Breaking Christmas is a 2022 Canadian Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Max McGuire from a screenplay by W. Stewart. Produced by Johnson Production Group, it stars Michelle Argyris and Andrew Bushell, with Danny Vo, Darlene Cooke, Tim Progosh, Pierre Simpson and Michael Gordin Shore in supporting roles. The film premiered on Lifetime in December 2022 and runs 85 minutes.

Leah Hoffman (Argyris) is an adjudicator for the World Records Bureau who every year has the honour of overseeing attempts to break Christmas-themed records, a job she does instead of properly celebrating the holiday. Just before Christmas she and her trainee Jin (Vo), an enthusiastic former engineer with a tendency to faint at the sight of beards or the sound of people singing in unison, are sent to the tiny town of St. Drexel, Illinois, which plans to attempt six world records. Having seen it all, Leah warns Jin not to get his hopes up, since most attempts fail. Spearheading the town's effort is its doctor, Devan Bancroft (Bushell). Thirty-five years earlier his mother helped St. Drexel set a record for the world's largest iced cookie, but the tourism it attracted has long since faded, and the businesses on Main Street now face closure unless the town can win new fame with feats such as the most hula hoop spins in one minute by people dressed as reindeer. While Devan is desperate for the town to succeed, Leah sticks rigidly to the rulebook, repeatedly checking how the bureau defines concepts such as vans, frogs or kissing, and delivers failed results with the gravity of a surgeon breaking bad news. As the townspeople gather to decorate their tree together on the eve of Christmas Eve, Devan's belief that sometimes one must give up an important job to live an important life challenges Leah's priorities, and she finds herself falling for him.

Critics found it slight but enjoyable. Decider compared it to a carton of eggnog, an acquired taste that goes down smoothly for those who like it, praising its original premise, its knowingly over-the-top treatment of Leah's devotion to the rules and Vo's committed supporting performance, while noting that it was less ambitious than other holiday romances that season. Cassandra Morgan recommended it as a cute film, praising Argyris as relatable and saying Bushell held his own as a leading man, though she wished it had shown more of the record attempts themselves.

title: Snow Day
tagline: Freeze the day.
overview: A pair of siblings make the most of a school snow day, while trying to avoid their nemesis, the Snowplowman.
plot:
Snow Day is a 2022 American musical comedy film directed by Michael Lembeck and written by Samantha Martin and Chris Viscardi. A Nickelodeon Movies production, it remakes the 2000 film of the same name, which Viscardi had helped conceive as a follow-up to The Adventures of Pete & Pete before it was rewritten as a standalone story. Reimagined as a musical, it follows two siblings who seize the chance to break their routines and take big risks when an unexpected snowfall closes their school. Ky Baldwin, Jerry Trainor, Rob Huebel, Laura Bell Bundy, Michaela Russell, Shelby Simmons and Fabi Aguirre star.

A year after a modest snowfall gave them the greatest snow day ever, teenager Hal Brandston and his younger sister Natalie face an unseasonably warm December in Syracuse, New York. Natalie badly wants another snow day so she can slide into the Christmas break without studying for her tests. Hal nurses a huge crush on Claire, but he is an awkward klutz whose stumble spilling ice cream over her shirt becomes a viral video, and she already has a boyfriend, Chuck Wheeler. After the siblings perform a song-and-dance plea for snow, a whiteout finally arrives and school is cancelled. Hal sets out to win Claire's heart, oblivious to the fact that his smart and funny best friend Lane has long had feelings for him. Natalie, meanwhile, schemes to stretch one snow day into two by thwarting the town's cranky, child-hating Snowplowman, who travels with a talking robotic crow and takes pleasure in clearing the roads so that the local children have to return to class. Their parallel adventures fill the day with musical numbers, and while Hal slowly comes to realise what has been in front of him all along, Natalie eventually faces off with the Snowplowman in the middle of the street.

Baldwin plays Hal, with Russell as Natalie, Trainor as the Snowplowman, Simmons as Claire, Aguirre as Lane, Myles Erlick as Chuck and Huebel as Tom Brandston. Production was announced in March 2022, and like the original it was shot mainly in Canada despite its Syracuse setting. Gabriel Mann composed the music, and the soundtrack album was released by Republic Records. The film premiered on Nickelodeon and Paramount+ on December 16, 2022, but was removed from Paramount+ in June 2023. Reviews were mixed: Decider's John Serba dismissed it as cheap fare for young children only, while Common Sense Media found that its dance numbers and clever songs could still raise a smile.

title: A Brush with Christmas
overview: Charlotte captures the local art scene also helping mother run the family restaurant. Charlotte throws out her painting, to the Christmas art festival. Wyatt seeing her discarded work tries to find the mysterious artist who stole his heart
plot:
A Brush with Christmas is a 2022 Christmas romantic comedy-drama television film produced by the Motion Picture Corporation of America and Brad Krevoy Television for the Great American Family network. It stars Jillian Murray as Charlotte and Joseph Cannata as Wyatt Graham, with Farrah Aviva as Ella, Jan Skene, Paul Essiembre and Michael Strickland. The film runs 85 minutes.

In the week leading up to Christmas in the town of Bayside, Charlotte is a painter trying to find her own distinctive style in the local art scene while also serving as head chef at her family's restaurant, which was her late father's dream and which she runs with her mother. She cherishes the family legacy, but her heart lies in painting, and her mother's expectations demand far more of her than an ordinary job would, especially during the busy holiday season. Torn between the restaurant and the Christmas picture she hopes to enter in the town's art festival, and lacking the time to do both well, a disheartened Charlotte throws her half-finished painting away. Meanwhile Wyatt, a successful artist well known in his field, is taking a much-needed break from a career built on computer-generated art, which he finds less fulfilling than drawing by hand, by visiting his friend David, who has recently moved to Bayside. David enters Wyatt in the festival, but as he gathers supplies he struggles to find a subject, and he soon finds himself distracted by a lovely local artist. Having stumbled on Charlotte's discarded work, Wyatt discovers that it has been anonymously submitted to the festival and uses the event's exposure to search for its mysterious creator, the artist who has captured his heart, while Charlotte must decide whether to make room in her life for her own art.

The film premiered on Great American Family on 18 December 2022 and was later made available on the Great American Pure Flix streaming service. Markos Papadatos of Digital Journal called it a stunning and poignant original holiday film with a moving message, praising Cannata as audacious and dashing and Murray as irresistible and bubbly, noting their good on-screen chemistry and singling out Aviva as delightful; he gave it "two giant thumbs up". The Review This Reviews blog recommended it as an easy, undemanding Christmas movie that offered pure entertainment and a welcome distraction from holiday stress, finding both leads endearing.

title: Hellhole
overview: In a monastery cut off from the world, the monks run a clinic for the possessed. One day, a young policeman Marek comes to the convent. Posing as a clergyman, he penetrates monastic life and tries to explain the recent, mysterious disappearance of several tormented inmates. It turns out, however, that there is no way out of the monastery.
plot:
Hellhole (Polish: Ostatnia wieczerza, literally "Last Supper") is a 2022 Polish horror film directed by Bartosz M. Kowalski, who co-wrote the screenplay with his frequent writing partner Mirella Zaradkiewicz. Set in 1987, it follows a police officer who goes undercover at a remote monastery to investigate mysterious disappearances and uncovers a dark truth about its clergy. Piotr Żurawski stars as Marek, with Olaf Lubaszenko as Prior Andrzej, Sebastian Stankiewicz as Piotr, Rafał Iwaniuk as Dawid and Lech Dyblik as Antoni.

In 1957, a priest tries to kill a baby bearing a distinctive scar but is shot dead by the militia. Thirty years later, Father Marek arrives at a monastery sanatorium where women are brought to be exorcized, secretly carrying a pistol and other forbidden items; his chest bears a scar like the baby's. Strange things happen in his room, but when he watches an exorcism marked by a shaking bed, gusts of wind and a burning cross, he later finds that the effects were staged. He struggles to eat the priests' food, and days later sees them bury a coffin, apparently for the woman whose room is now empty. Piotr, the vice-prior, warns him in the confessional that those who disobey are severely punished, and Marek reveals that he is a militiaman disguised as a priest to look into the disappearance of local women. Piotr claims that the prior fakes exorcisms to cheat the Church but says he does not know what becomes of the women. Digging up the grave, Marek finds it empty and is captured and force-fed cooked meat. He breaks free, kills Dawid and finds the missing women's bodies hanging in a freezer, realizing he has been eating them. Piotr explains that the monks believe Marek is the "chosen one", born during an eclipse, who after a ritual of eating the flesh of seven sinners and drinking the blood of an innocent will become a demon and usher in a new world order. Piotr then betrays him. The prior reveals that the tip that drew Marek there was a lure and that the church stands over a well serving as a portal to hell. The monks slit a young woman's throat and make Marek drink her blood, but nothing seems to happen; Piotr stabs Marek, throws him into the well and smothers the prior to take control. The next morning Piotr dissolves into a cloud of flies, and a now-demonic Marek suspends the priests upside down in the pose of crucifixion.

The film, available on Netflix, holds a 60% Rotten Tomatoes rating from a small number of reviews.

title: The Lost Lotteries
original_title: ปฏิบัติการกู้หวย
tagline: The loser team up for a lost cause.
overview: Five down-on-their-luck strangers must band together to steal back winning lottery tickets worth millions from a wicked mafia boss.
plot:
The Lost Lotteries (Thai: ปฏิบัติการกู้หวย) is a 2022 Thai crime comedy film directed by Prueksa Amaruji, the director of Bikeman and its sequel, and produced by GMM Studios. It stars Wongravee Nateetorn as Tay, Phantira Pipityakorn as Beat, Padung Songsang as Wen, Napapa Tantrakul as Zoe and Somjit Jongjohor as Khung, with Thanaporn Wagprayoon as Tay's mother Toi, Anusorn Pinyopojanee as the crime boss Chye and Torpong Kul-On and Somyos Matures as his henchmen Mee and Doe. The film runs 106 minutes under the tagline "The loser team up for a lost cause."

In Bangkok, where many people turn to the national lottery for a little daily hope, Tay is a business student and chess fanatic whose life seems to be a series of bad luck episodes. After his mother Toi is injured falling through an open sewer, he takes over her work selling lottery tickets after school. When Boss Chye, the leader of the local syndicate, sends his goons Mee and Doe to collect on a loan Toi cannot repay, they seize her lottery tray and all its tickets as collateral. Just then, five of those tickets turn out to be winners worth millions, but without the tray there are no receipts, and the four other ticket holders, Khung, Zoe, Beat and Wen, each desperate after hard times of their own, arrive demanding to know what Tay will do about it. The gangsters will not hand the tickets back, the police are either afraid of Chye or on his payroll, and none of them is a professional thief. With no other choice, the five strangers agree to Tay's outlandish and audacious plan to infiltrate the boss's lair in disguise and steal the tickets back, a scheme that requires a series of backup plans and lands one of them in an illegal backroom boxing match against the real-life Muay Thai champion Rodtang Jitmuangnon.

The film was released worldwide on Netflix in November 2022. Johnny Loftus of Decider recommended it, enjoying its madcap slapstick and the performances of Songsang and Jongjohor while finding its toilet humour and dubbed-in sound effects tiresome. Amanda Guarragi of Ready Steady Cut called it wacky, fast-paced and funny despite one-note characters, while Rahul Shinde of The Envoy praised the cast but felt the film tried too hard to be funny, making it a one-time watch.

title: Barbie Epic Road Trip
overview: In this interactive adventure, Barbie goes on a cross-country trek with friends and makes big decisions about the future. Which dream will she choose?
plot:
Barbie Epic Road Trip (also styled Barbie: Epic Road Trip) is a 2022 American computer-animated interactive adventure comedy special directed by Conrad Helten and written by Aury Wallington, with Ann Austen also credited as a writer. Based on Mattel's Barbie franchise and released on Netflix on 25 October 2022, it is the 41st entry in the Barbie film series and the first interactive production in the franchise, letting viewers choose what the characters do at key points of the story. Its title was first revealed by Mattel co-president Richard Dickson in a presentation to analysts in February 2022.

Barbie "Malibu" Roberts (America Young) and her best friend Barbie "Brooklyn" Roberts (Tatiana Varria) pack up the pink van and head east from Malibu to Brooklyn, having been invited to audition as backing singers for the pop star Jacinda (Alba Ponce de Leon). Along the way they deliver foster dogs to forever homes found through Match Mutts, the new app launched by Barbie's younger sister Skipper (Kirsten Day), while Ken (Ritesh Rajan), who has come along for the ride, tries to tell Barbie how he really feels about her. The viewer decides, among other things, whether the group takes the scenic route or the express route, which song they perform, whether Barbie and Ken become more than friends, and which detours to follow. The journey crosses the country with stops at notable places and includes a ghost story told on the road, a creepy mansion where a vampire seems to appear from nowhere, aliens making spooky noises and a hang-gliding flight that nearly ends in a crash. Depending on the choices made, the story can reach six different endings, in which the Barbies land record deals or gigs, Skipper finds an investor for her app, or Barbie must weigh her career against her relationship with Ken, one of them ending in a kiss.

The voice cast also includes Cassidy Naber as Chelsea, Cassandra Lee Morris as Stacie, Greg Chun and Lisa Fuson as Barbie's parents George and Margaret, Nicolas Roye as Rafa and Dino Andrade as Magnifico. The special's single, "Flip the Script", performed by Lydia Li and produced by The Math Club, was released on 17 October 2022. Common Sense Media rated it suitable for ages five and up, praising its portrayal of responsible, generous and entrepreneurial young adults, the smooth weaving of its alternative storylines and the sweetness of the foster-dog plot, though it found Brooklyn's forced slang cringeworthy.

title: The Apology
tagline: Revenge is a mother.
overview: Twenty years after the disappearance of her daughter, recovering alcoholic Darlene Hagen (Anna Gunn) is preparing to host her family's Christmas celebration with her best friend Gretchen (Janeane Garofalo). Late Christmas Eve, Darlene's estranged ex-brother-in-law, Jack (Linus Roache) arrives unannounced, bearing nostalgic gifts and a heavy secret. Soon, Darlene finds herself caught between reason and ruthless instinct. Trapped together by a dangerous storm, a battle of wits escalates to a violent game of revenge.
plot:
The Apology is a 2022 American psychological horror thriller written and directed by Alison Star Locke in her feature debut. Anna Gunn stars as Darlene Hagen, a woman still haunted by her daughter's disappearance, with Linus Roache as her former brother-in-law Jack and Janeane Garofalo as her best friend Gretchen. Produced for the horror streaming service Shudder, it was released on 16 December 2022.

Twenty years after her daughter vanished without a trace, Darlene, a recovering alcoholic who has rebuilt her life, is preparing for a quiet family Christmas at her isolated house in the countryside. On Christmas Eve, her best friend, Gretchen, visits to offer support, and the two talk about the past and about the grief that still shapes Darlene's life. Long after Gretchen leaves, Jack, the brother of Darlene's late husband, arrives unannounced in the middle of a snowstorm, bringing gifts and claiming that he wants to reconnect.

At first the reunion is awkward but cordial, as the two reminisce about the family and Jack speaks of his own attempts to live a better life. As the night wears on and the snow traps them inside the house, cut off from the outside world, Jack's behavior grows strange, and he eventually reveals the terrible secret he has kept for two decades about what happened to Darlene's daughter. The revelation turns the evening into a tense battle of wills between Darlene and Jack, as accusations, confessions and violence escalate. With no way to escape and no one coming to help, the confrontation becomes a brutal game of revenge and survival, in which Darlene must decide what she is willing to do to learn the full truth and make Jack pay for what he has done.

The Apology received mixed reviews, with a 52 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 46. Simon Abrams of RogerEbert.com gave it three stars out of four, calling it a grim and mostly satisfying locked-room thriller about Darlene and Jack's complicated relationship. Critics generally praised the performances of Gunn and Roache, while some found the script's twists and dialogue uneven.

title: Detective Knight: Redemption
overview: In custody in New York, Detective James Knight finds himself in the middle of a jailbreak led by The Christmas Bomber, a brutal fanatic whose Santa Claus disciples are terrorizing the city. With the promised return of his badge in exchange for taking out the terrorists, the steely-eyed Knight doles out mercy for the just...and merciless justice for all the rest.
plot:
Detective Knight: Redemption, also known as Christmas Knight, is an American Christmas-set action thriller from 2022. Edward John Drake directed and co-wrote it with Corey Large, who also produced alongside Randall Emmett and George Furla for Emmett/Furla Oasis, BondIt Media Capital and Buffalo 8 Productions. The second installment of the Detective Knight trilogy and a sequel to Detective Knight: Rogue, it stars Bruce Willis as Detective James Knight and Paul Johansson as the villain Ricky Conlan, with Lochlyn Munro, Miranda Edwards, Beau Mirchoff, Corey Large, Jimmy Jean-Louis, Michael Eklund and John Cassini as Mayor Vassetti. The music is by Scott Currie.

Following the events of the first film, Knight is in custody in New York for the killings of the criminals Winna and Brigga. During the Christmas season, a riot breaks out in the prison, led by Ricky Conlan, a brutal fanatic known as "The Christmas Bomber", whose followers, the "Real Saints of Christmas", dress as Santa Claus and terrorize the city. With the police stretched thin outside the walls, the authorities need a man on the inside to crush the uprising, and Knight is caught in the middle of the jailbreak. He strikes a deal: in exchange for taking out the terrorists, he will be reinstated and get his badge back. As the bomber's disciples spread chaos across the city, Knight sets out to stop them, showing mercy to the innocent and merciless justice to the rest, with the help of colleagues including Fitzgerald (Munro) and Anna Shea (Edwards).

The film was shot back to back with the third installment in Vancouver from November to December 2021 under the working title Christmas Knight, and was retitled in September 2022. Several actors reprised their roles from the first film, while Johansson, Cassini and Jerry Yu joined the cast. It is among the final films of Willis, who retired from acting after being diagnosed with aphasia, a condition later identified as frontotemporal dementia. Lionsgate released it in limited theaters and on demand on 9 December 2022, followed by DVD and Blu-ray on 17 January 2023. Critics were largely negative: Movie Nation and Blu-ray.com dismissed it as dull, and Common Sense Media noted that Willis appears even less than in the first film, with tricks to film around him that often fail. Film Threat and Midwest Film Journal were more positive, calling it an entertaining crime caper for fans who know what to expect.

title: Dive
overview: Mariel is a veteran elite diver who has one last chance at the Olympic Games. However, when a terrible truth comes to light, Mariel faces her biggest personal question: Is winning her true dream?
plot:
Dive (Spanish: La caída) is a 2022 sports drama directed by Lucía Puenzo and starring Karla Souza, a Mexican, Argentine and American co-production that explores sexual and psychological abuse in the world of elite sport. The screenplay was written by Puenzo with Mónica Herrera, Samara Ibrahim, Tatiana Mereñuk and María Renée Prudencio, and the cast includes Hernán Mendoza, Dèja Ebergenyi, Fernanda Borches, Claudia Lobo, Enrique Singer, Mabel Cadena and Christian Vázquez. Inspired by a true story, it was released exclusively on Amazon Prime Video on November 11, 2022, in more than 240 countries and territories.

Souza plays Mariel, a veteran Mexican diver who is fighting for what is likely her final chance to compete at the Olympic Games, as preparations get under way for Athens 2004. She is battling physical problems as well as the passing of time, and her career is bound up in a complicated relationship with Braulio, played by Mendoza, who is both her longtime coach and her romantic partner. title: The Soccer Football Movie
overview: When mysterious green slime monsters start popping out of soccer balls, all-star athletes Zlatan Ibrahimović and Megan Rapinoe must team up with their four biggest fans to stop evil scientist "Weird Al" Yankovic from stealing their talent.
plot:
The Soccer Football Movie is a 2022 American animated family comedy film directed by Mitch Schauer and produced by Splash Entertainment for Netflix. The football stars Zlatan Ibrahimović and Megan Rapinoe voice animated versions of themselves, with "Weird Al" Yankovic as the villain, the sportscaster Rob Stone, and Kieran Walton, Madison Zamor, Tania Gunadi, Arnie Pantoja, Ian James Corlett, Tom Kenny, Grey DeLisle and Deeki Deke in the voice cast. The film runs 73 minutes and was released shortly before the 2022 FIFA World Cup.

A group of four young, avid soccer fans are desperate to meet their heroes, the "All-Stars" Ibrahimović and Rapinoe, and find themselves in the wrong place at the wrong time when an evil scientist played by Yankovic sets out to steal the talent and skills of the world's greatest players. He invents a green goo that turns into monstrous slugs, and mysterious slime creatures begin popping out of soccer balls; when Ibrahimović opens a gift box hoping to find a jetpack, a slug merges with him and drains away his abilities. Taken over by the slugs, the players, and eventually Yankovic himself, are transformed into huge green mutant versions of themselves. The two athletes must team up with their four biggest fans, who are honest, hardworking players in their own right, to stop the scientist, and the children's reliance on practice and fair play is set against his magic serum. Along the way they face a living monster ponytail, chases and fights, and a running joke about passing gas, before a final battle with a giant spider-like creature with a deadly stinger.

The film was released on Netflix on 9 November 2022 and received negative reviews. Scott Hines of Decider compared it to a present-day Space Jam and enjoyed Yankovic's villain and Rapinoe's turn, but found Ibrahimović's performance grating and the film aggressively goofy, with little character development or pacing, recommending that viewers skip it. John Sooja of Common Sense Media found Rapinoe and Ibrahimović excellent but judged its terrifying monsters too scary and violent for its intended young audience, and Ewan Gleadow of Cult Following called it a disaster, criticising animation in which models clipped through one another or failed to move.

title: Mickey Saves Christmas
tagline: Mickey and his friends help Santa save Christmas!
overview: Mickey, Minnie and their pals attempt to celebrate the perfect Christmas at their snowy cabin. However, when Pluto causes Santa to lose all the presents on his sleigh, the friends travel to the North Pole on a quest to save Christmas.
plot:
Mickey Saves Christmas is a 2022 American stop-motion animated Christmas television special directed by David H. Brooks and written by Kim Duran. Produced by Disney Television Animation with Stoopid Buddy Stoodios, the studio behind Robot Chicken, it premiered simultaneously on ABC, Disney Channel, Disney Junior and Disney XD on 27 November 2022 and arrived on Disney+ the next day. Running about 24 minutes, it was described by Brooks as the longest stop-motion Mickey Mouse production to date, and the first Disney Television Animation special on ABC since 1999. Set in Hot Dog Hills, the home of Disney Junior's Mickey and the Roadster Racers, it features original songs by Laura Schein and Ben Zeadman, with a score by Zeadman.

Mickey Mouse (Bret Iwan) is busy decorating a snowy cabin for the perfect Christmas and fetching his friends Minnie (Kaitlyn Robrock), Donald (Tony Anselmo), Daisy (Debra Wilson) and Goofy (Bill Farmer) from town, while his dog Pluto (also Farmer) keeps trying to get him to play. When Mickey finally takes Pluto out, a game of fetch goes wrong and the decorations are switched off just as Santa Claus (Brock Powell) is coming in to land. His sleigh crashes, and the presents meant for the children of the town, among them Susie (Natalie Coughlin), Pearl (Stella Edwards) and Elray (Nick Kishiyama), are lost. Because the elves have already gone home for the holidays, Mickey and his friends volunteer to help and travel to the North Pole, accidentally leaving the reindeer Prancer behind. While Santa and Mrs. Claus (Camryn Grimes) go back to find him, the gang set to work making new gifts in Santa's workshop, despite more trouble caused by Pluto. With Santa still not back and time running out, they repair one of his old sleighs and hitch up two young reindeer, and when that is not enough, Pluto joins the team. They meet up with Santa in time to deliver the gifts, and Mickey learns that spending time with the people you love matters more than perfect decorations.

Songs include "Christmas Is Nearly Here", "We Can Fix This Christmas" and "You Light Up Christmas". It was the first special with Wilson voicing Daisy. Reviews were mixed. Bubbleblabber's David King rated it 7.5 out of 10, comparing it to classic Rankin/Bass specials and praising its fluid animation, though finding the story predictable, while Erin Snyder of Mainlining Christmas dismissed it as an empty branding exercise.

title: Christmas on Mistletoe Farm
overview: After inheriting a farm at Christmas time, a widowed father makes a bumpy adjustment to village life — while his kids hatch a plan to stay there forever.
plot:
Christmas on Mistletoe Farm is a 2022 British Christmas family comedy written and directed by Debbie Isitt, creator of the Nativity! films, who also composed its original music with her partner, Nicky Ager. Scott Garnham stars as Matt Cunningham, a widowed father of five, with Scott Paige as the eccentric farmhand Beano, Ashley Jensen as Matt's hard-nosed boss, Ms Fletcher, Kathryn Drysdale as the village vet, Miss Ashley, Celia Imrie as Miss Womble, head of the village knitting circle, and Inel Tomlinson as Matt's colleague Mo.

Matt works for a firm in London and has been handed a make-or-break pitch to a potential client on Christmas Eve, a deal on which his whole department's jobs depend. Just when he needs peace and quiet to prepare, he learns that he has inherited the farm of his estranged father, who abandoned Matt and his mother decades earlier. Encouraged by his five children, by his colleague and by an imagined voice of his late wife, he packs up the family and leaves London for Mistletoe Farm, near the village of Cobbledon, hoping to use it as a retreat to finish the pitch.

Matt quickly regrets the decision. The farm has no power or Wi-Fi, a leaking roof, faulty plumbing, a fridge of rotten eggs and dozens of animals to look after, and it lives with Beano, a larger-than-life farmhand who sleeps in the barn and entertains the children. The farm is also losing money and at risk of being bought by developers. While Matt struggles to work, Beano, the children and Cobbledon's quirky residents, have other ideas. They draw him into village traditions such as the lighting of the town Christmas tree, for which his father always supplied the farm's best tree, and the Hoedown Snowdown, as they try to persuade him that family and community matter more than work, and that the Cunninghams should make Cobbledon their home.

As with the Nativity! films, much of the movie was shot in the West Midlands, with Matt's office in central Birmingham, while Cobbledon's exteriors were filmed in the Cotswolds and the farm was Fulling Mill Farm in north Oxfordshire. Netflix released it on 23 November 2022. Reviews were largely negative: Decider's Brett White praised Garnham's grounded performance but found the broad barnyard humor, cartoonish supporting characters and maudlin moments exhausting, recommending viewers skip it, and other critics faulted the predictable plot while appreciating the scenery and child cast.

title: Don't Leave
overview: Semih's girlfriend suddenly breaks up with him. In search of answers about their relationship, he must soon confront what he had long ignored.
plot:
Don't Leave (Turkish: Kal) is a 2022 Turkish romantic drama film directed by Ozan Açıktan from a screenplay by Sami Berat Marçalı. Produced by OGM Pictures, it stars Burak Deniz and Dilan Çiçek Deniz, with Şükran Ovalı, Ersin Arıcı, Berrak Tüzünataç, Ceyda Düvenci and Dolunay Soysert in supporting roles. It was released on Netflix on 11 November 2022 and runs 107 minutes.

Semih (Burak Deniz), a charming but chaotic young professional artist, is stunned when Defne (Dilan Çiçek Deniz), his girlfriend of many years, abruptly ends their live-in relationship, leaving him alone in the apartment they once shared and without any sense of closure. The break-up sends him spiralling, outwardly into bleached hair, self-satisfaction and attempts at new flings, from a heated make-out at a party to a clumsy effort to seduce his estate agent during a viewing, and inwardly into anxious self-reflection. As he tries to move on, the narrative moves seamlessly between the present and the past, as small everyday moments, such as a visit to a dry cleaner's or a brief conversation, send his mind back to his time with Defne. Their first meeting was as dramatic as their parting: at a bar run by his friend, a tipsy Semih tried to kiss her before even saying hello, and she angrily dismissed him as weird and rebuffed his relentless advances, though the two eventually became a couple. Defne appears only in his memories, which reveal Semih's impulsive, temperamental and self-absorbed nature, his habit of making grand gestures instead of apologising, and his manipulative treatment of friends, colleagues and the women attracted to him. Too proud to contact Defne yet eager to know what she is saying and posting, he searches the highlights of their relationship for a single mistake that ended it, until a confrontation with her forces him to face what he had long ignored and to accept a more mundane truth about love.

Reviews were mixed. Mrinal Rajaram of Cinema Express gave it three out of five, calling it an engaging, often brooding exploration of a break-up and praising the subtle shifts between timelines and the device of showing Defne only through Semih's memory. Marshall Shaffer of Decider recommended skipping it despite a commanding, charismatic lead performance by Burak Deniz, comparing it to (500) Days of Summer and finding that its clever cutting masked a lack of substance, with paper-thin supporting characters and few fresh insights.

title: Encanto at the Hollywood Bowl
overview: A taped performance of the Encanto Live-to-Film Concert Experience at the Hollywood Bowl. The original cast puts on a miracle of a concert as they sing the favorite songs, accompanied by a full orchestra and 50 person ensemble, and the Hollywood Bowl transforms into Casita!
plot:
Encanto at the Hollywood Bowl is a 2022 American concert special released on Disney+ that presents live stage performances of the songs from Disney's Academy Award-winning animated film Encanto (2021). It was filmed before packed audiences on 11 and 12 November 2022 at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles, where the film was screened with a live-to-picture score while its voice cast performed the musical numbers in costume. The streaming version, about 45 minutes long, trims the event down to the songs and a few dance sequences. It features Stephanie Beatriz as Mirabel, Jessica Darrow as Luisa, Diane Guerrero as Isabela, Adassa as Dolores, Carolina Gaitán as Pepa, Mauro Castillo as Félix, Angie Cepeda as Julieta and Olga Merediz as Abuela Alma, with guest appearances by the Colombian singers Carlos Vives and Andrés Cepeda.

Songwriter Lin-Manuel Miranda, who wrote the film's original songs alongside composer Germaine Franco, introduces the show, noting that it marks the first time the original cast has sung together on stage, since the film was made during the pandemic. Projection mapping, lighting and video effects transform the amphitheater into the Madrigal family's magical casita, while dancers, prop performers, a full orchestra and a Colombian band fill the stage. Beatriz opens with "The Family Madrigal," introducing the rest of the family, and the cast perform the film's six character songs with choreography by Jamal Sims and Kai Martinez, who had choreographed the film. Darrow delivers a lighthearted "Surface Pressure," Guerrero sings amid floral imagery, and "We Don't Talk About Bruno" features dancers in rat costumes and a giant Bruno puppet moving through the audience. A brief segment shows Miranda checking in with the Elemental Choir as it rehearses "Dos Oruguitas," sung on stage by Andrés Cepeda in place of Sebastián Yatra, and Carlos Vives closes the show with "Colombia, Mi Encanto," leading into a fireworks finale.

The special premiered on Disney+ on 28 December 2022, about a year after Encanto became a phenomenon through its streaming debut. Disney retained the live vocals. Alex Reif of Laughing Place praised the inventive visuals and noted that, while the actors occasionally missed notes, they sold the songs through their characterizations. Johnny Loftus of Decider recommended it, calling it Beatriz's show and praising its energy and spectacle, though he felt the choir interlude was filler.

title: Christmas Full of Grace
overview: After discovering a betrayal, Carlinhos takes a fun stranger to accompany him on Christmas. But Graça proves to be a madwoman capable of bringing the traditional family home down.
plot:
Christmas Full of Grace (Portuguese: Um Natal Cheio de Graça) is a 2022 Brazilian Christmas romantic comedy directed by Pedro Antonio and written by Carolina García and Fil Braz. It stars Sérgio Malheiros as Carlinhos, Gessica Kayane as Graça and Vera Fischer as Lady Sofia, the matriarch of Carlinhos's wealthy family, with a supporting cast that includes Monique Alfradique, Leticia Isnard, Heitor Martínez and Diogo Defante. It was filmed in the Leblon neighborhood of Rio de Janeiro between November and December 2021.

Carlinhos plans to propose to his girlfriend Bebela on Christmas Eve, just before the two are due to attend his family's traditional holiday dinner at his grandmother's mansion. Moments before, he discovers that she has been cheating on him with another woman. Heartbroken, he rushes out of their apartment and runs into Graça, an outspoken, free-spirited stranger who offers to pose as his girlfriend so that he will not have to explain the breakup to his family.

Carlinhos reluctantly accepts the plan, but quickly realizes it was a mistake, as the uninhibited Graça shakes up the formal dinner in Lady Sofia's mansion. As the holidays go on, he learns that Graça lost her father, who used to work as Santa Claus, and that since his death she has spent every Christmas with a different family to avoid being alone. The more time they spend together, the closer Carlinhos and Graça become. When Bebela suddenly reappears and Graça's secret is exposed by Carlinhos's cousin, the fake relationship falls apart, and Carlinhos must decide whether he can trust his feelings before the New Year arrives.

The film follows the familiar fake-relationship formula of holiday romantic comedies, mixing family chaos, humor and the theme of finding belonging during Christmas.

Christmas Full of Grace premiered on Netflix on November 30, 2022. Among its memorable moments are a visit to a Christmas festival where Graça runs into one of the families she once spent the holidays with, and a reconciliation at a New Year's Eve party.

title: Mindcage
tagline: The art of the kill.
overview: Detectives Jake Doyle and Mary Kelly seek the help of an incarcerated serial killer named The Artist when a copycat killer strikes. While Mary searches for clues in The Artist's brilliant but twisted psyche, she and Jake are lured into a diabolical game of cat and mouse, racing against time to stay one step ahead of The Artist and his copycat.
plot:
Mindcage is a 2022 American supernatural mystery thriller directed by Mauro Borrelli from a screenplay by Reggie Keyohara III, based on a story by Borrelli; the two had previously worked together on WarHunt. It gave Martin Lawrence his first dramatic, non-comedy lead, as the veteran detective Jake Doyle, opposite Melissa Roxburgh as his younger partner Mary Kelly and John Malkovich as the imprisoned serial killer Arnaud Lefeure, known as the Artist. Robert Knepper plays Lieutenant Owings, with Neb Chupin as Dr. Loesch, Jacob Grodnik, Aiden Turner, Ritchie Montgomery as Father Linares and Chris Mullinax as a homeless man.

Over five years, the Artist murdered six women, decorating their bodies and posing them in elaborate, quasi-religious public tableaux, before Doyle caught him; he now spends his days on death row in Arkansas making charcoal drawings in his cell. Years later, women begin turning up dead again, sculpted and posed like angels in apparent homage to his work. With the toll rising, Doyle and Kelly turn to the Artist for help. Since he resents the man who caught him, Kelly becomes the point of contact, and he agrees to cooperate in exchange for having his death sentence commuted to life in prison.

As Kelly probes the Artist's brilliant but twisted mind, he speaks in riddles, holds forth on the corruptibility of the human mind and questions her about recurring nightmares from her adolescence, while she is harassed by a seemingly homeless stranger and the clues left on the bodies point toward people from the detectives' own past. Kelly's devout, oddly behaved boyfriend becomes a suspect, a kidnapped politician adds a ticking clock, and the two detectives are drawn into a game of cat and mouse as they try to stay ahead of both the Artist and his imitator. In its final stretch the film turns to the supernatural, revealing that the Artist's reach extends far beyond the walls of his cell.

Shot in Springdale and Fayetteville, Arkansas, in August 2021, the film was released by Lionsgate in a small number of theaters and on demand on 16 December 2022. Critics were largely negative, comparing it unfavorably with The Silence of the Lambs, Seven and Fallen; TheWrap found it clichéd and illogical, and The A.V. Club faulted its flat script while praising Malkovich's droll performance. It later found a wide audience on Netflix, entering the platform's global top ten in January 2024.

plot:
Santa Camp is a 2022 British comedy-drama film that follows the story of a group of young women who form a girl band in a summer camp for aspiring pop stars. The movie explores themes of female empowerment, self-discovery, and the struggles of growing up.

At its core, Santa Camp is a heartwarming tale about a group of young women finding their voices, both literally and metaphorically, as they navigate the challenges of adolescence and the cutthroat music industry. Through the characters' experiences, the film sheds light on the importance of female friendship, support, and solidarity in the face of adversity.

The movie also touches on themes of identity, creativity, and the pressure to conform to societal expectations. As the girls navigate their relationships with each other and the camp's strict rules, they must confront their own desires, aspirations, and sense of self-worth.

Ultimately, Santa Camp is a feel-good film that celebrates the power of female friendship, creativity, and perseverance in the face of adversity. With its lighthearted tone, engaging characters, and uplifting message, the movie is sure to leave audiences feeling inspired and uplifted.

title: Who's a Good Boy?
overview: Chema has a mission: to date Claudia, the attractive new girl at his school, and lose his virginity. Can he fulfill his dream before graduating?
plot:
Who's a Good Boy? (Spanish: El Guau) is a 2022 Mexican teen sex comedy written and directed by Ihtzi Hurtado. Sebastian Dante stars as a high school senior desperate to lose his virginity, with Sirena Ortiz, Harold Azuara, Diego Meléndez, Luisa Guzmán Quintero, Adrián Vázquez and Grettell Valdez in supporting roles. The title refers to a slang term for a boy who devotedly serves a girl he loves while being kept in the friend zone. The film was released worldwide on Netflix on November 23, 2022.

Chema is in his final year of high school and is mortified that all his friends have already had sex while he cannot even manage a conversation with a girl. His fun-loving uncle Jaime arrives for a visit, offering plenty of advice about women and lending him his truck. When the principal assigns Chema to show the glamorous new student Claudia around, she quickly seems interested in him, but he is too nervous to respond. He begins driving her to school and accompanying her to dance classes. Meanwhile, his longtime friend Eli, who wants him to play in a band with her for the school's Christmas posada, is hurt to see him spending all his time with Claudia.

At a party at Claudia's house, she tries to seduce Chema, but fear paralyzes him again. When his family hears what happened, his sister warns him that he is in danger of becoming Claudia's "guau," a loyal pet who does everything for a popular girl without ever being considered as a boyfriend. Claudia asks him to the posada, but then secretly invites another boy, Sebas, to her house, and when Chema sneaks in on them, a humiliating mishap leaves his clothes behind. Claudia insists they are best friends and announces she is going to the dance with Sebas, offering to help him ask Eli instead.

At the posada, Chema and Eli are having a wonderful time until Claudia and Sebas goad him into admitting that he really wanted Claudia, and Eli, overhearing, walks out. Eli rejects his apologies for weeks, and Jaime abruptly leaves town. As graduation approaches, Chema publicly declares that nobody should have to be a "guau," winning applause and even Sebas's respect. At graduation he turns Claudia down when she finally makes a move, wins Eli back, and decides to give up his planned engineering degree to pursue his true passion, music. The film ends on the class trip to Cancún, where the new couple are caught together in an airplane bathroom.

title: The Boss Baby: Christmas Bonus
overview: Christmas Eve takes a twisty turn when the Boss Baby accidentally swaps places with one of Santa's elves and gets stranded at the North Pole.
plot:
The Boss Baby: Christmas Bonus is a 2022 American computer-animated Christmas comedy special produced by DreamWorks Animation for Netflix. Directed by Matt Engstrom and Christo Stamboliev and written by Tanner Tananbaum and J.D. Ryznar, it is based on characters from the television series The Boss Baby: Back in Business and Marla Frazee's picture book. JP Karliak voices the title character, with Pierce Gagnon as Tim, George Lopez as Santa Claus, Ray Chase as the elf Ding Dong Dongle, and Alex Cazares, Kevin Michael Richardson, David W. Collins, Hope Levy, Max Mittelman, Ariana Greenblatt and Jodi Benson in other roles. Running about 45 minutes and rated TV-Y7, it was released on Netflix on 6 December 2022.

As the grand finale of the family's Christmas traditions, the adult Tim Templeton (Mittelman) tells his daughters Tabitha (Greenblatt) and Tina the story of the first Christmas of his baby brother Theodore "Ted" Templeton, the Boss Baby. The grumpy, suit-wearing baby despised every holiday ritual, so on Christmas Eve the young Tim (Gagnon) takes him, dressed as an elf, to meet Santa at the mall. To Tim's surprise, Santa and the Boss Baby recognise each other: Santa is a former Baby Corp employee who betrayed the company by poaching half its staff for his "toys-for-nothing" programme. When the Boss Baby trips into a mail bag, he is accidentally swapped with Dongle, the North Pole's finest toymaker, and is carried off to Santa's workshop, while Dongle ends up at the Templeton home, where he worries that without him the world will be flooded with inferior toys. As Tim calls on Baby Corp colleagues Staci (Cazares) and Jimbo (Richardson) to sort out the mix-up, the Boss Baby takes charge of the workshop, hunting for inefficiencies, pushing reforms to raise revenue and stirring the elves to strike against their anonymous role in Santa's old-fashioned operation. The chaos threatens Christmas and lands Santa himself on the naughty list, and the Boss Baby must find his way home to celebrate with his family and discover what the Christmas spirit means.

Reviews were mixed. Movieguide rated it three out of four, calling it fun, family-centred entertainment with jokes about economics and private enterprise, though a step down from the feature films in animation and story. Anju Devadas of High on Films found its verbal humour only mildly amusing and its low-key animation unimpressive, while acknowledging the efforts of Lopez, Chase and Karliak.

title: Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All!

overview: Filmed in New York City at Madison Square Garden, the concert special will feature the singer-songwriter performing a repertoire of Carey's festive holiday hits, including the perennial favorite, “All I Want for Christmas Is You.”
plot:
Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All! is a 2022 American television concert special starring the singer Mariah Carey, broadcast by CBS and streamed on Paramount+. The two-hour program was taped on 13 December 2022 at Madison Square Garden in New York City and serves as a network television version of the holiday residencies Carey staged between 2014 and 2019. Carey acts as host and master of ceremonies, backed by a full band and gospel choir under her music director Daniel Moore, and is joined by her twins, Monroe and Moroccan, the Rockettes and guests including Billy Porter, Jermaine Dupri, Slick Rick and Drew Barrymore.

The special opens with Madison Square Garden lit in red outside; inside, Carey descends to a stage dotted with Christmas trees, wearing a grand tiara and trilling to "Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy" from The Nutcracker. The set mixes carols such as "O Holy Night," "Joy to the World" and a solemn "Silent Night" with her own holiday songs, among them "Christmas Time Is in the Air Again," co-written with Marc Shaiman, "Miss You Most (At Christmas Time)" and "When Christmas Comes." Porter performs "Jesus Had a Mama Like Mine," the Rockettes appear in candy cane costumes for "Oh Santa!," and Dupri and Slick Rick, introduced by Carey's son, join a lively "Here Comes Santa Claus." Carey also performs a medley of her non-holiday hits, including "Honey," "Fantasy" and "We Belong Together," sings "Away in a Manger" as a duet with her daughter, and appears on a big screen while children, among them her own, perform a cover of the Waitresses' "Christmas Wrapping." Barrymore comes on stage to pay tribute to the host before the finale, a festive performance of Carey's 1994 hit "All I Want for Christmas Is You" with her children, the Rockettes and a shower of streamers and artificial snow.

Merry Christmas to All! aired on CBS on 20 December 2022 and was simultaneously streamed on Paramount+. According to Deadline, it averaged 3.91 million viewers and was the most-watched broadcast of the night, winning each of its half hours and becoming the top live-streamed entertainment program on Paramount+ that day. Johnny Loftus of Decider recommended it, describing it as an easily consumable, singalong-friendly holiday special that blends spectacle with Carey's off-the-cuff banter and further cements her image as the season's feel-good queen.

title: Prancer: A Christmas Tale
overview: Ten-year-old Gloria and her recently widowed grandfather Bud befriend a mysterious reindeer when the family gather for Christmas. Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home.
plot:
Prancer: A Christmas Tale is a 2022 family fantasy drama film directed by Phil Hawkins and a belated third entry in the Prancer series that began with the 1989 film Prancer, released by Universal Pictures Home Entertainment. James Cromwell stars as Bud, a recently widowed and cantankerous grandfather, with Darcey Ewart as his granddaughter Gloria, alongside Sarah-Jane Potts, Aaron McCusker as Gloria's uncle Gerald, and Joseph Millson.

Bud is still grieving the loss of his wife, and his sorrow has made him grumpy, short-tempered and withdrawn. Though he cares deeply for his family and holds to strict principles, he clashes constantly with his two adult children, and he is determined to avoid being placed in a nursing home. At Christmas his 10-year-old British granddaughter, Gloria, comes to stay. Curious, energetic and kind, but sometimes disobedient, she is also dealing with the strain in her parents' rocky relationship and her father's frequent absences, and she likes to film whatever interests her on her smartphone and share it online.

When Bud and Gloria discover a mysterious reindeer living near the family home, the two find common ground. Gloria's persistence wins over her reluctant grandfather, and together they follow the trail of the reindeer, the magical Prancer of the title. Their adventure brings them into conflict with a hunter who wants to shoot the animal, while family tensions over money, including the possible sale of a valuable family house, and the motives of Gloria's money-minded uncle Gerald come to a head. Through his bond with Gloria and the reindeer, Bud begins to open up about his grief, and the family's strained relationships move toward reconciliation in time for Christmas, with the story celebrating loyalty to family, caring for animals, valuing people over money and believing in the spirit of the season.

The film was produced with Sky Cinema. It was released on digital platforms and home video in the United States on November 22, 2022. Alistair Lawrence of Common Sense Media described it as a low-stakes, feel-good holiday drama that spins a decent odd-couple story out of a vague premise, crediting the on-screen chemistry between Cromwell and Ewart for keeping a lightweight script watchable, while noting that the family conflicts are resolved too neatly, that the pursuit of Prancer relies heavily on exposition, and that a stronger villain would have helped.

title: The Cosmos Sisters
tagline: It's showtime, baby.
overview: Now in their late 20s, two former bandmates and best friends reconnect in their hometown and decide to get the band back together.
plot:
The Cosmos Sisters is a 2022 American independent comedy-drama film written and directed by Whitney Uland and Nora Kaye, who also star as two lifelong best friends. Produced by Kookisimo Productions and Outer Darkness Films and filmed in Florence, Massachusetts, it co-stars Jake Swain, Madeline Grey DeFreece, Alexander Manuel, Arielle Haller-Silverstone and Shelley Kuefner. It was released on demand by Gravitas Ventures on 20 December 2022 and runs 78 minutes.

Whitney (Uland) and Nora (Kaye), friends since childhood, once performed together as the Cosmos Sisters, a musical act with catchphrases and garishly coloured wigs that they performed at their school's homecoming halftime. Now in their late twenties, they have drifted apart. Nora, still living in their small hometown, has slipped into a funk after her mother's death, while Whitney, a skin-care influencer and product-review vlogger based in Brooklyn, was too busy to be there for her when it mattered. Claiming to be acting at the request of Nora's boyfriend (Swain), Whitney arrives in town for a one-woman intervention, promising to take a break from Instagram, help her friend through her grief and perhaps sort out the barn full of belongings her mother left behind, though Nora suspects an ulterior motive. When the pair revive a little of their old act for Whitney's Instagram channel, a viewer asks them to play a benefit show for her son, who has cancer, and Whitney decides to get the band back together. As Nora digs out her guitar, her boyfriend wishes she would clear out the barn instead, and Whitney finds time to flirt with a former classmate (DeFreece), now a pizza delivery driver, whom she ignored in high school. Along the way the friends visit another classmate (Manuel), whom Whitney once snubbed but who has become a successful musician and producer, confronting past mistakes and the ways they have grown apart.

Roger Moore of Movie Nation found the leads so convincing as old friends, from their shorthand banter to their biting but never terminal fights, that he wondered whether they were childhood friends in real life, but called the film feather-light, cute rather than deep or insightful, and not very funny, singling out Manuel's single scene as a highlight. Chris Jones of Overly Honest Movie Reviews was more positive, praising the well-written, character-driven treatment of friendship and redemption despite some struggles to keep a consistent tone.

title: Lesson Plan
overview: After a teacher dies, his best friend — a former cop — takes a job at the school where he worked to confront the gang he thinks was responsible.
plot:
Lesson Plan (Polish: Plan lekcji) is a 2022 Polish action crime film directed by Daniel Markowicz from a screenplay by Daniel Bernardi and released by Netflix. It stars Piotr Witkowski as Damian Nowicki, a former undercover police officer nicknamed Jiu-Jitsu, alongside Antonina Jarnuszkiewicz as his colleague Agata, with Jan Wieczorkowski, Nicolas Przygoda, Daniel Namiotko, Rafał Zawierucha, Zuzanna Galewicz, Pascal Fischer, Marcin Bosak and Roma Gąsiorowska in supporting roles. The film runs about 100 minutes and borrows the familiar premise of an outsider teacher facing an unruly class, filtered through B-movie martial arts action.

The film opens with Damian, who has infiltrated a drug gang posing as a criminal, fighting his way unarmed through a group of machine gun-wielding henchmen after the mafia discovers his identity and murders his wife. He brings down the boss and the entire ring single-handedly but is left a broken man who sinks into alcoholism. His best friend, a history teacher, asks him to look into the drugs flooding the high school where he works, and Damian at first refuses. When the friend dies, Damian decides to uncover the gang he believes is responsible and takes his late friend's vacant post as a history teacher at the modest school. There he faces uncooperative students, but he wins over the good ones, preparing his lessons conscientiously while spending more time teaching them jiu-jitsu for self-defense as they try to resist the dealers in their school. He also grows close to Agata, a fellow teacher, though a misunderstanding strains their relationship. As the investigation touches on dark themes including sexual harassment and a student's drug overdose, Damian closes in on the dealers, and the film ends with the revelation of the real villain behind them.

Lesson Plan premiered on Netflix on 23 November 2022 with a 16+ rating. Reviews were negative. Vinayak Chakravorty of Firstpost gave it two stars out of five, likening Witkowski to a Polish Jean-Claude Van Damme and calling the film an honest B-movie stuntfest, but faulting its clichéd, mechanical script, underdeveloped characters, tacky fight choreography and lack of chemistry in the romance. Avinash Ramachandran of Cinema Express also gave it two stars, praising the neatly orchestrated combat sequences and Damian's earnest attempts to be a good teacher while criticizing the lazy writing, predictable twists and the lack of emotional impact in its darker moments.

title: Kangaroo Valley
overview: Journey to a secret valley in Australia, where a nervous baby kangaroo named Mala faces hungry dingoes and winter snows in this coming-of-age adventure.
plot:
Kangaroo Valley is a 2022 nature documentary film made for Netflix, directed by Kylie Stott, written by Tab Murphy and produced by Ample Nature. Narrated by Sarah Snook, it is a coming-of-age story about a nervous baby eastern grey kangaroo named Mala who must survive hungry dingoes and winter snow during her first year out of the pouch. The film features "We Can Do Anything," a new song by the Australian pop star Sia, and was released on December 14, 2022.

In a lush valley in Australia, the joey Mala emerges from her mother Lowanna's pouch for the first time. Unlike the playful joey Buru, who loves to hop, Mala is reluctant to leave the safety of the pouch. Her father, Bamir, is the largest buck in the valley and the leader of the kangaroo mob. On the edge of the valley lies the Black Forest, scorched by recent wildfires, which is home to a dingo pack led by the white dingo Migaloo. His son, Miro, is the same age as Mala and still learning to hunt; in one chase he pursues a mother kangaroo whose joey tumbles from her pouch but manages to escape. The narration notes that only one in five kangaroo joeys lives to see its first birthday, so Mala has much to learn if she is to survive.

The valley is home to many other animals, including a grumpy wombat named Warrin, an energetic willie wagtail, a koala, sugar gliders and colorful parrots. When a wedge-tailed eagle threatens the joeys, the alarm calls of smaller birds warn the kangaroos. On their next hunt, the dingoes scatter the mob, separating Mala from Lowanna, and surround and kill Bamir. Mala eventually finds her way back to her mother. Winter brings snowstorms and food becomes scarce. When a new litter of pups arrives, Miro is driven from the pack and struggles to feed himself. By spring, Mala and Miro are both living on their own, and in a final hunt they meet head to head; Mala outruns the young dingo and escapes. As a new season's joeys begin to emerge from their mothers' pouches, the cycle of life in the valley continues.

Kangaroo Valley was released on Netflix as part of its slate of wildlife documentaries. Johnny Loftus of Decider called it crisply shot, warmly told and full of interesting facts, while Amanda Guarragi of Ready Steady Cut praised the coming-of-age story that sets it apart from other wildlife documentaries.

title: Reno 911!: It's a Wonderful Heist
tagline: An arresting new holiday movie.
overview: It’s Holiday Season in Reno, and Lieutenant Dangle wishes he’d never been born. With the help of a roller skating “Angel,” he learns how much better the lives of the other deputies would be if he never existed. Will he decide to live on anyway? There’s still Christmas criminals to catch!
plot:
Reno 911!: It's a Wonderful Heist is a 2022 American Christmas comedy television film based on the mockumentary police series Reno 911!, created by Thomas Lennon, Kerri Kenney and Robert Ben Garant. Directed by Christian Hoffman and written by Lennon and Kenney, it reunites series regulars Lennon, Kenney, Cedric Yarbrough, Wendi McLendon-Covey, Joe Lo Truglio, Ian Roberts, Mary Birdsong, Carlos Alazraqui and Niecy Nash, with Nick Swardson, Toby Huss and Bobby Moynihan. Produced by Comedy Central, MTV Entertainment Studios and High Sierra Carpeting, the roughly 80-minute special aired on Comedy Central in December 2022, more than a decade after the original series ended its run on the channel and following a revival season on Quibi.

It is the holiday season in Reno, and Lieutenant Jim Dangle (Lennon), apparently having lost his savings in cryptocurrency, stands atop the Sierra Nugget Mall wishing he had never been born. In a riff on Frank Capra's It's a Wonderful Life, he wishes on the Christmas star and Terry (Swardson) appears as his roller-skating guardian angel to show him what the world would be like without him. All the deputies turn out to be better off: Trudy (Kenney) is a world-renowned suit wearer and glass harpist, Clementine (McLendon-Covey) has disrupted the coffin industry with iPad-enabled caskets, and Jones (Yarbrough) runs Reno's hottest fondue restaurant, the Melting Crock. Dangle must decide whether to carry on, with Christmas criminals still to be caught. The main thread follows the deputies' efforts to guard a prized silver nugget at the mall, owned by a character played by Moynihan, alongside a Christmas pageant in which Trudy plays a wise man bearing frankincense, while the department deals with Reno's familiar parade of offenders, including Kenney's Jackie the prostitute, Huss's Big Mike and Nash's perpetually pixelated T.T.

Matt Schimkowitz of The A.V. Club called it a holiday miracle that delivers on its premise so effectively that its only real fault is a lack of ambition, praising the escalating belly laughs and the cast's skilled sketch work but noting that the all-gags approach buckles near the end, when the plot threads need tying up. The blog A Very Atheist Christmas felt it played out like a long regular episode but enjoyed the mall setting and Trudy's turn as a wise man.

title: Delivery by Christmas
overview: When a spiteful coworker sabotages her deliveries, a courier and a helpful customer must race to return Christmas presents to their intended recipients.
plot:
Delivery by Christmas (Polish: Jeszcze przed świętami) is a 2022 Polish Christmas romantic comedy film directed by Aleksandra Kułakowska and Maciej Prykowski, who co-wrote the screenplay with Maria Pułaska-Białkowska. Produced by Robert Kijak for Next Film, with music by Andrzej Smolik, it stars Monika Frajczyk and Piotr Pacek, with Dorota Kolak, Mirosław Baka, Łukasz Simlat, Zdzisław Wardejn, Marek Kalita, Łukasz Gawroński and Franciszek Krupowicz. It was released on Netflix on 6 December 2022 and runs about 100 minutes.

In Warsaw, Marysia (Frajczyk), a harried single mother who works for a courier company, is so busy before Christmas that she has to bring her young son Maks (Krupowicz) along on her rounds in her battered delivery van. In an office building, Maks wanders off to a restroom and is helped by Krzysiek (Pacek), a legal executive trying to finish contracts before the holiday, before making a mess in his office, so Marysia owes him a favour. She agrees to collect his grandmother's engagement ring from his grumpy, prank-loving grandfather (Wardejn), as Krzysiek plans to propose to his live-in girlfriend on Christmas Eve, but the old man sends a joke object instead. Meanwhile, after Marysia rebuffs an unwanted drunken kiss from her new boss, a hard-drinking, unhappy loner, he takes revenge by swapping the labels on her deliveries. On Christmas Eve, as most of Poland stays home to celebrate, Marysia, with an irate Krzysiek tagging along, races across the city to put things right while also tracking down her own gift for Maks. The misdirected parcels, among them an ultrasound photo, a doll with a hidden flash drive and a pair of slippers, upend the lives of their recipients, including a lonely woman (Kolak) ignored by her husband (Kalita) and an unmotivated man (Gawroński) still living with his parents, while two police officers become comically involved. As the day goes on, Marysia and Krzysiek grow closer.

Reviews were mixed. Decider recommended it as a sweet, modestly charming film, likening it to a Polish Love Actually and praising Frajczyk's grounded performance as a working-class single mother who holds the film together amid gently stereotyped supporting characters. Roger Moore of Movie Nation felt that much of its charm and potential cuteness was lost to a stumbling structure, as repeated jumps back in time to show each mistaken delivery killed the pace and lowered the stakes of the central romance.

title: I Believe in Santa
overview: Lisa thinks she's finally met the man of her dreams until she finds out he still believes in Santa Claus.
plot:
I Believe in Santa is a 2022 American romantic Christmas comedy directed by Alex Ranarivelo and written by John Ducey, who also stars opposite his real-life wife Christina Moore; it was Ducey and Ranarivelo's latest holiday collaboration after A Christmas Mystery and A Hollywood Christmas. Produced by ESX Entertainment, it co-stars Violet McGraw, Sachin Bhatt, Lateefah Holder and Matthew Glave.

Lisa (Moore), a journalist, has just finished an article arguing that the Fourth of July is the nation's greatest holiday, far superior to commercialized Christmas. When her ex-husband once again fails to look after their daughter Ella (McGraw), Lisa takes the girl to an Independence Day festival with her best friend Sharon, where Ella is due to perform. Ella gets separated from her group and is found by Tom (Ducey), a lawyer offering free legal advice at a booth with his colleague and best friend Assan. When Lisa finds her daughter with a stranger she fears the worst, but the misunderstanding is quickly cleared up, the four watch the fireworks together, and over the following months Lisa and Tom fall in love. As the holidays approach, however, Tom reveals that he is not only obsessed with Christmas but genuinely believes in Santa Claus. He fills their days with skating, caroling, tree trimming and cookie baking, and Lisa at first plays along for Ella's sake, while worrying that Tom is filling her daughter's head with fantasies. Ella secretly tells a department store Santa that her wish is for her mother and Tom to marry. Lisa, who has hated the holidays ever since a painful Christmas disappointment from her parents, cannot convince Tom that Santa does not exist, and when her boss assigns her an article about Christmas, she breaks up with him. Later, when Ella's father lets her down before a big cardboard sled race, she asks to be taken to Tom, who skips The Nutcracker to help her fix her sled, while Lisa talks with Assan about Tom's devotion. Ella and her mother win the race, Tom promises to tone things down next year and proposes, Ella reveals her wish, and Lisa ends up writing a tribute to Christmas.

The film was released worldwide on Netflix on 14 December 2022. Critics were unenthusiastic: Film-rezensionen.de found the debate over Santa's existence thin and the humor unremarkable, though worth a look for devoted Christmas fans, and Kino&Co dismissed it as bottom-of-the-drawer holiday fare that wasted McGraw's talent.

title: Pelosi in the House
tagline: A home movie by Alexandra Pelosi.
overview: Documentarian Alexandra Pelosi offers a candid, behind-the-scenes chronicle of the life of her mother and Speaker of the United States House of Representatives, Nancy Pelosi, through her career milestones leading up to the inauguration of President Joseph Biden in January 2021.
plot:
Pelosi in the House is a 2022 American documentary film directed by Alexandra Pelosi about her mother, Nancy Pelosi, the longtime congresswoman who served as Speaker of the United States House of Representatives. Produced by HBO Documentary Films and described in its tagline as a home movie, the 110-minute film was the director's fourteenth documentary for HBO and draws on more than two decades of footage she shot while following her mother through the halls of Congress. Editor Geof Bartz worked with the filmmaker, who largely acted as her own one-person crew.

Rather than using talking heads or expert analysis, the film adopts a vérité approach. It sketches the Pelosi family's political legacy, recalling that Nancy's father served in Congress and as mayor of Baltimore, and traces her early steps in politics and her rise after she was first elected to the House in 1987. Its most absorbing passages focus on process: a long sequence shows Pelosi working the phones from cars, family gatherings and her office to secure votes for the Affordable Care Act, and other glimpses include her improvised home video-conferencing setup during the COVID-19 lockdown. About half an hour of the second half is devoted to the January 6, 2021, attack on the Capitol, combining the director's footage of lawmakers being rushed to secure locations with surveillance and outside material, including Pelosi's angry remarks about President Donald Trump. The chronicle continues through the inauguration of Joe Biden and closes with her decision not to remain in party leadership after the 2022 midterm elections, while her husband, Paul Pelosi, appears only briefly.

The documentary premiered on HBO on 13 December 2022, after excerpts of its January 6 footage had already drawn attention when they were used by the House Select Committee investigating the attack; in 2024 a House oversight subcommittee requested further raw footage, which HBO turned over. Reviews were mixed to positive. The San Francisco Chronicle called it essential viewing, and The New York Times valued the rare chance to watch Pelosi negotiate legislation and rally votes. Daniel Fienberg of The Hollywood Reporter found it uneven, choppy and rushed and felt it revealed the politician more than the person, but praised its fascinating moments of access and the thriller-like momentum of the January 6 section.
